description: This file defines a custom JSON decoder extending Go's encoding/json.Decoder to support navigating JSON streams with path-based seeking and token handling.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: An extended JSON decoder supporting path navigation, seeking, and token differentiation.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the extended JSON Decoder.

methods.name: SeekTo
methods.description: Moves the decoder to a specified path within the JSON structure.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes the next JSON value into the provided variable.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the current JSON path as a slice.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, distinguishing between keys and values.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Advances through the JSON stream, executing actions on matching paths.
